annotation.title_clean: טיוטת הנחיית הרשות להגנת הפרטיות: תחולת הוראות חוק הגנת הפרטיות על מערכות בינה מלאכותית
annotation.title_en: Draft Guideline of the Privacy Protection Authority: Application of the Privacy Protection Law to Artificial Intelligence Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Privacy Protection Authority (הרשות להגנת הפרטיות)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Draft guideline (April 2025) by Israel's Privacy Protection Authority setting out its interpretation of the Privacy Protection Law as applied to AI systems, ahead of Amendment 13 taking effect. Covers informed consent, scraping, accountability, impact assessments, accuracy, data security, and database registration.
key_provisions_or_claims: Privacy law applies to AI models that store or process personal information in training and deployment, including inferences.
Informed consent requires disclosure of AI operation, bot interaction, and training purposes; scraping without informed consent is a privacy violation.
Recommends privacy impact assessments, DPO appointment, and board oversight for high-risk AI.
Data subjects' correction rights may extend to correcting the algorithm; enforcement focus on accuracy.
Security duties address inference attacks and generative AI use; registration authority may be used to refuse unlawful AI databases.
